Nodes contain exact source quotations, never rewritten sentences. A node may have
multiple quotations for discontinuous evidence. Occurrence is zero-based among
exact overlapping matches. Code assigns node IDs; use zero-based node indices in edges.
Represent expressed requests, questions, assertions, predicates and participants.
Preserve negation, modality, quantities, temporal scope, conditions, exceptions,
attribution, quoted-content roles, corrections and coordination explicitly.
Edges go from the qualified/head node to its dependent: action -> condition,
assertion -> attribution, predicate -> patient, reference -> possible antecedent.
Every edge also requires exact source evidence for its proposed attachment.
An exception permitting an action does not itself request that action. An attributed
claim is not an established fact. Do not silently resolve ambiguity or contradiction.
For uncertain edges use status=uncertain; multiple uncertain refers_to edges retain
candidate antecedents without selecting one. Record uncertainty in nodes as well.
Use unrepresented nodes for content this schema cannot express, and unknown edges
for unsupported relation categories. Do not force a guess to fit the schema.
Cover all meaningful input, but prefer specific spans to blanket quotations.
Empty output and uncited text are diagnostic outcomes, not successful understanding.
